# H&H Nail Spa

> Woman-owned nail spa based in Pflugerville, Texas. Dip, gel, full sets and relaxing Duplex pedicures at a woman-owned nail spa on W Pecan St in Pflugerville. Mix your own custom color, settle into a brand-new spa chair, and leave with a set you love.

- Phone: (512) 300-0253
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch, Manor, Austin
- Google rating: 4.5 from 115 reviews

## Services
- Dip & gel manicures: Long-lasting dip powder and gel manicures, including custom colors we mix just for you.
- Pedicures: Duplex, gel and detox pedicures in our new, modern spa chairs. Sit back and relax.
- Full sets & nail art: Acrylic full sets, pink and white, French tips, ombré and custom designs, from swirls and glitter to monograms and 3D flowers.

## About
H&H Nail Spa has been on W Pecan St in Pflugerville since 2019. Some clients have been coming since the doors opened, and regulars know it as Lyndsey's salon: woman-owned, spotless, welcoming and relaxing. Clients mention the people first. Wendy for relaxing Duplex pedicures, Kim for full sets, fills and designs, and a team that will happily mix different dip powders into a custom color or finish with a dip top coat so turmeric stains don't stick. The spa now has new, modern pedicure chairs, and the pricing is the kind regulars call reasonable.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you mix a custom dip color?
  A: Yes. Tell us the shade you're after and we'll combine dip powders to make it. Clients love how unique their colors turn out.
- Q: What is a Duplex pedicure?
  A: It's our most relaxing pedicure and a favorite with regulars. Call (512) 300-0253 and we'll walk you through what's included.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Call ahead at (512) 300-0253 and we'll let you know when a chair is open. Many clients call and come in within the hour.
- Q: Can you finish dip without a gel top coat?
  A: Yes. If gel top coats stain for you (turmeric and curry cooks know), ask for a dip top coat instead.
- Q: Do you do eyebrows?
  A: Yes. Eyebrow waxing is on the menu, and some regulars won't let anyone else touch their brows.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 800 W Pecan St, Ste B2, Pflugerville, TX 78660. Open Monday to Saturday, 9:30 am to 7 pm.
